title: FBI-UAP-D030, FD-302, “Large Triangle with Red Lights,” 2023
doc_notes: This is an FBI FD-302 interview report documenting a civilian's sighting of a triangular aerial object, which includes a report of electronic interference during a subsequent phone call.

encounters.summary: A witness observed a large, solid black triangular object with red lights at each corner emerging from a pixelated cloud, exhibiting non-conventional flight maneuvers and high-speed acceleration.
encounters.quote: saw what appeared to be a dark-gray colored cloud phasing into his sight
